name: JLPT — For Examinees: Let's Try Sample Questions!
content_type: 官方样题入口/说明页：N1–N5 全级别，One sample question is offered for each test item type；指向 sample09.html（2009 年 New Japanese-Language Proficiency Test Sample Questions，可下载 PDF/MP3）与 sampleindex.html（Official Practice Workbook，2012 / 2018 Vol.2，Bonjinsha 销售）
coverage: N1–N5 全级别样题；N3 三大科目与时间（guideline/testsections.html 原文）：Language Knowledge(Vocabulary)〈30min〉、Language Knowledge(Grammar)・Reading〈70min〉、Listening〈40min〉。N3 题型构成（○有/―无）：文字词汇 Kanji reading ○ / Orthography ○ / Word formation ― / Contextually-defined expressions ○ / Paraphrases ○ / Usage ○；语法 Sentential grammar 1 ○ / Sentential grammar 2 ○ / Text grammar ○；读解 Comprehension (Short passages) ○ / (Mid-size passages) ○ / (Long passages) ○ / Integrated comprehension ― / Thematic comprehension (Long passages) ― / Information retrieval ○；听解 Task-based comprehension ○ / Comprehension of key points ○ / Comprehension of general outline ○ / Verbal expressions ○ / Quick response ○ / Integrated comprehension ―
access_method: 网站公开免费；forlearners.html 本身只给说明与链接；实际可下载资源在 https://www.jlpt.jp/e/samples/sample09.html：N1–N5 各自试题 PDF、答题纸 PDF、听解脚本 PDF、答案 PDF、听解 MP3；PDF 需 Acrobat Reader，非日语环境需 Asian Font Packs；无 API
update_status: forlearners.html 无最后更新日期；所指向的 sample09.html 明确 (published 2009)、为 2010 改版前样题，并附 List of changes in directions (PDF/103KB) 提示部分指导语此后有变更；sampleindex.html 提到 2012 与 2018 两版官方练习册。另同批核验的 guideline/testsections.html 显示 2026 JLPT dates: 1st test Sunday, July 5 / 2nd test Sunday, December 6，说明站点当前维护。免费样题本身为旧版，需注明
license: 所访问页面未见任何许可/版权/再利用条款文本，未核实。样题由 JLPT 官方公开发布供考生练习，页面说明用途为 show the form of test items 并注明 There may be differences from questions in the actual test booklet.；再分发/改作/商用授权未核实。
usage_scope: 页面说明样题用于展示题型，且提示与实考题册可能有差异；未见再利用授权，未核实。
role_in_project: N3 题型与官方样题的权威依据，用于确定题库的题型分类、难度锚点与评测标准；不宜直接再分发原题。
quality_risks: ① 样题为 2009 年改版前编制，题量/指导语与现行考试有差异，不能当作现行真题；② 官方练习册为 Bonjinsha 付费出版物，免费部分仅样题；③ 未见许可条款，再分发/商用未核实；④ sample_kousei.pdf 与 N3-mondai.pdf 为 application/pdf，WebFetch 返回 non-text resource，无法解析，本次仅经 curl -I 确认 HTTP 200 与 Content-Type，未读取题目正文（按规则不批量抓取受限版权教材）；⑤ 无 API、无结构化数据。

name: JLPT — N1-N5: Summary of Linguistic Competence Required for Each Level
content_type: 官方能力标准说明页，N1–N5 五级，每级按 Reading / Listening 列出能力描述（配 levelsummary_read.gif / levelsummary_listen.gif 图标）；含总述（各级定位、N3 为 bridging level、语言知识另属必需）
coverage: N1 / N2 / N3 / N4 / N5 五级；每级含 Reading 与 Listening 要点；总述说明 N4/N5 测课堂基础日语、N1/N2 测广泛实际场景、N3 为 bridging level；并说明 While not noted in the table, Language Knowledge, such as Vocabulary and Grammar, is also required。N3 原文要点：能力概要「The ability to understand Japanese used in everyday situations to a certain degree.」；Reading「One is able to read and understand written materials with specific contents concerning everyday topics.」「One is also able to grasp summary information such as newspaper headlines.」「In addition, one is also able to read slightly difficult writings encountered in everyday situations and understand the main points of the content if some alternative phrases are available to aid one's understanding.」；Listening「One is able to listen and comprehend coherent conversations in everyday situations, spoken at near-natural speed, and is generally able to follow their contents as well as grasp the relationships among the people involved.」
access_method: 网站公开免费 HTML 页面；无下载、无 API；页面内含 gif 图标与指向 https://www.jlpt.jp/e/application/overseas_list.html 的考试日程链接
update_status: 页面未给出最后更新日期或版本号；含页脚「＊Outside Japan, the test may be held only in July or December in some cities.」；同批核验的 testsections.html 含 2026 年考试日期，说明站点当前维护
license: 所访问页面未见任何许可/版权/再利用条款文本，未核实。属官方公开发布的能力标准说明，供了解各级要求；引用需注明出处。
usage_scope: 官方公开发布的能力标准说明，供了解各级要求；未见再利用授权，未核实。
role_in_project: N3 能力目标与难度锚点的权威定义，可直接作为分级目标、评测维度（Reading/Listening）与课程大纲设计依据；原文要点可短句引用。
quality_risks: ① 仅给能力描述，不提供词汇表/语法表/汉字表或题量，需另找资料；② 页面明确 Language Knowledge, such as Vocabulary and Grammar, is also required，表格不覆盖语言知识，不能当作完整考纲；③ 未见许可条款，引用需注明出处；④ 无更新日期/版本号，需固定快照；⑤ 为英文版，日文原版表述可能略有差异，本次未核验。

evidence: 标题「N1-N5: Summary of Linguistic Competence Required for Each Level | JLPT  Japanese-Language Proficiency Test」；「The JLPT has five levels: N1, N2, N3, N4 and N5. The easiest level is N5 and the most difficult level is N1.」；「N4 and N5 measure the level of understanding of basic Japanese mainly learned in class.
